mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods of upward GDPC1 trend despite no extreme volatility.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity present value, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of ultra-low federal funds rates (<2%) and robust quarterly GDP growth (>5%) creates favorable conditions for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite both FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and GDPC1 growth > 5.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in supply indicators (INDPRO > 105) coupled with historically low unemployment (UNRATE < 2%) signals a robust economic environment, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite both INDPRO > 105.0 and UNRATE < 2.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in the CPIAUCSL index reflects accommodative monetary policy, lowering real interest rates and enhancing equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite sustained upward movement in CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS > 150,000) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1 > 5%) and strong demand for final goods (RSAFS > 450,000) creates a virtuous cycle of corporate profits and equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite both GDPC1 growth > 5.0% and RSAFS > 450,000 in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A dual signal of ultra-low federal funds rates (<1.5%) and historically low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) during a post-shock recovery phase indicates economic stabilization, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite both UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5% in the same period.
